text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: It has drummed up excitement like never before, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen...!

Catching her breath, Fuji Kiseki waved
toward the roaring stands.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Everyone's cheers are the fuel that drives me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Yasuda Kinen.
In other words, the battlefield best suited for these legs—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please don't miss out on the next miracle,
one that certainly won't pale in comparison...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"That was so fun! Man, Fuji Kiseki
might really win every single race just like she said!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: No, no, you're getting ahead of yourself. It's only a sprint race so far~.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-sama really is number one!
The continuation of the Classic year is right here~!

Fuji Kiseki's performance at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen
rapidly took over the headlines—

The video surpassed 1 million views, and the issue
of Monthly Twinkle featuring her sold out everywhere.
It was already starting to reach the level of a social phenomenon.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, sorry, sorry!
I was just lost in thought!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, the press is here too, aren't they?
We don't have time to space out!

Next was the mile race, the Yasuda Kinen.
As Fuji Kiseki raced across the turf,
flashes from the press chased relentlessly after her.
